instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Bonsai/Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not use the Blender Python console, Text editor scripts, Python, IfcOpenShell, shell commands, or any helper script/macro to directly generate or edit the deliverable files. Use only Bonsai/Blender native GUI tools, panels, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Create a new one-storey apartment model in Bonsai with assigned materials, then save the completed IFC4 model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc using Bonsai's graphical save/export controls. Start from a blank project; no local reference images are provided. The IFC model should have one project and one building storey named Level 00. Include exactly four real IfcSpace objects named Living, Kitchen, Bedroom, and Bath; exactly seven IfcWall elements; exactly three IfcDoor elements; exactly four IfcWindow elements; exactly one IfcSlab element; and no IfcBuildingElementProxy objects. Use Bonsai's graphical material assignment panels to assign every wall the ordered material layer sequence Brick, Insulation, Gypsum. Assign every door the material Timber and every window the material Aluminium. Do not create a CSV schedule or any separate report file; the material and element requirements must be represented directly in result.ifc. Other non-required IFC metadata may vary as long as the saved model satisfies these stated GUI-created IFC requirements.
